item.title: King Charles visits execution site of 1823 slavery uprising
item.body: The King visited the site where British authorities put down one of the largest uprisings of the colonial era. The 1823 uprising was against slavery, and the site is where executions took place.

photo.credit: White House / Public domain, Wikimedia Commons

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 👑 King Charles visits execution site of 1823 slavery uprising

The King visited the site where British authorities put down one of the largest uprisings of the colonial era. The 1823 uprising was against slavery, and the site is where executions took place.

Source: The Independent | Image: White House / Public domain, Wikimedia Commons
